# temps_environment_runtime_health (Resource)

Whether Temps watches an environment's running replicas and how many must be healthy. Destroying the resource turns watching off.

Import with `<project_id>/<environment_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `environments:read`, `environments:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_environment_runtime_health" "staging" {
  project_id     = temps_project.web.id
  environment_id = temps_environment.staging.id
  enabled        = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Watch the replicas.
- `environment_id` (Number) ID of the environment.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Optional

- `paused` (Boolean) Keep the policy but stop acting on it, for example during maintenance.
- `required_healthy` (Number) Replicas that must be healthy; unset means all of them.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>/<environment_id>`.
- `reason` (String) Why the environment is in that state.
- `state` (String) Current health state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<environment_id>
terraform import temps_environment_runtime_health.staging 8/21
```
